notes.title: First Update - Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
We've been hard at work this week to fix some of the problems according to the feedback you've given us. We've also polished up a lot of features.

The most notable additions are keyboard controls and a singleplayer training mode.

[b]Full changelist:[/b]
- Keyboard controls for up to 2 players
- Single Player Training Mode
- New Map Textures
- New Shaders
- Various UI Changes
- New Menu
- New Loading Screen
- Bug Fixes Starpower
- Added Sound Effects

And many more bugfixes!

notes.title: Switch & Ditch releases for Steam!
notes.content:
We are a team of 15 students that have created our first game in a mere 8 ~ 11 weeks! Together, we are proud to announce Switch & Ditch. 

Switch & Ditch is a game where you have to steal the spotlight by pushing away your friends and foe to make sure you stay in the spotlight! Increase the size of your head by standing in the stars' spotlight to increase your fame, flip your enemies behind you or dash into other players to push them off the map!
